from datetime import date, timedelta, datetime
from pyspark.sql.functions import *
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from py4j.protocol import Py4JJavaError
import pandas as pd
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from decimal import Decimal
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, IntegerType, ArrayType, StringType, LongType, DecimalType, FloatType, TimestampType
year_quarter = "2025_3"
year_month = "202506"

# get the function to retrieve sql properties
%run Utility/getSQLConnectionString

# retrieve sql connection_string and connection_properties
jdbcUrl,conn_Prop = getSQLConnectionString()

trx_private = spark.sql(f"""
    with stazioni as 
        (SELECT id_stazione, servizio,servizio_pof,
        CASE 
            WHEN servizio = 'gpd-payments/api/v1' OR servizio = '/gpd-payments/api/v1' THEN 'ASYNC'
            WHEN servizio_pof = 'gpd-payments/api/v1' OR servizio_pof = '/gpd-payments/api/v1' THEN 'ASYNC'
        ELSE 'SYNC'
        END AS tipo_chiamata
        FROM pagopa.stazioni)
    SELECT gp.payment_id, gp.payment_date_time, sc.internalistitutionid, sc.taxcode, sc.description, s.tipo_chiamata, cs.prezzo_unitario
    from pagopa.enti sc inner join pagopa.transaction_raw gp on sc.taxcode = gp.pa_fiscal_code
    INNER JOIN stazioni s
    ON gp.partner_station = s.id_stazione
    INNER JOIN pagopa.catalogo_stazioni cs
    ON s.tipo_chiamata = cs.tipo_chiamata AND gp.payment_date_time > cs.datainiziovalidita AND gp.payment_date_time < cs.datafinevalidita 
    where
    product = 'prod-pagopa' AND
    origin IN ('SELC', 'PDND_INFOCAMERE') AND
    institutiontype IN ('PRV', 'GPU')
    AND sc.notificationtype='UPDATE'
    AND gp.year_quarter = '{year_quarter}'

df_contracts = spark.sql(f"SELECT * FROM pagopa.contracts_raw WHERE year_month= '{year_month}'")
    
df_contracts_providers = df_contracts\
                                .withColumn("provider_list", split(col("provider_names"), ","))\
                                .withColumn("provider_id", explode(col("provider_list")))
df_transactions = spark.sql(f"select payment_id, payment_date_time, psp_id, total_amount, isPosFisico, client_id from pagopa.transaction_raw where year_quarter = '{year_quarter}'")
Join transazioni contratti per recuperare categoria e ordino le transazioni in base alla data

# Left join bewteen transactions and contracts on provider_id
df_trx_join_contracts = df_transactions.join(df_contracts_providers, df_transactions.psp_id == df_contracts_providers.provider_id, "left")

clientIdLst = ["IO","CHECKOUT", "CHECKOUT_CART", "WISP"]


windowSpec = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("payment_date_time")

df_trx_contracts = df_trx_join_contracts\
    .filter(col("membership_id").isNotNull())\
    .withColumn("category", when((col("contract_type") == "A") & (col("isPosFisico")==True), "A1")
                .when((col("contract_type") == "B") & (col("total_amount") < 5000) & col("client_id").isin(clientIdLst), "B1")
                .otherwise(concat(lit("G_"), col("membership_id"))))\
                .withColumn("row_number", row_number().over(windowSpec))\
                .select("payment_id","recipient_id","category","payment_date_time","row_number")
fasce_psp = spark.sql(f"select * from pagopa.fasce_psp where year_quarter = '{year_quarter}'").withColumn("current_total", col("current_total").cast(LongType()))
Seleziono tra le transazioni ordinate quelle dei privati
# df_trx_private_ranked = df_trx_contracts
df_trx_private_ranked = trx_private.join(df_trx_contracts, how="inner", on="payment_id")

df_G = df_trx_private_ranked.where("category not in ('A1','B1')")

df_non_G = df_trx_private_ranked.where("category in ('A1','B1')")

df_non_G_final = df_non_G.withColumn("CodiceArticolo",when(col("category")=="B1","B.1").when(col("category")=="A1","B.3"))\
                        .withColumn("Value",when(col("category")=="B1","0.04").when(col("category")=="A1","0.025"))\
                        .select("payment_id","recipient_id","internalistitutionid","taxcode","description","category","prezzo_unitario","tipo_chiamata","CodiceArticolo","Value")\
                        .withColumn("Value", col("Value").cast(DecimalType(10,4)))\

#  .select("payment_id","category","payment_date_time","CodiceArticolo","Value")

- Esplodo il df sull'array delle fasce e ottengo in ogni riga il numero di transazioni di una categoria in una certa fascia

- Filtro le righe che hanno numero di transazioni a 0 o a null escludendo così le fasce vuote e quelle riempite in un quarter precedente

fasce_exploded = fasce_psp.select("*", posexplode("currentBasket").alias("basket", "trans"))\
                    .where("trans is not null and trans <> 0 and left(category,1) = 'G'")\
                    .withColumn("trans", col("trans").cast(LongType()))
display(fasce_exploded)
Creo una tabella con le posizioni di ogni fascia e i codici articolo

fasce = [
    (0, "A.1", 0.0850),
    (1, "A.2", 0.0723),
    (2, "A.3", 0.0679),
    (3, "A.4", 0.0638),
    (4, "A.5", 0.0575),
    (5, "A.6", 0.0563),
    (6, "A.7", 0.0552),
    (7, "A.8", 0.0541),
    (8, "A.9", 0.0530)
    ]
    
# Define the schema for the DataFrame

schema = StructType([
    StructField("fascia_key", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("CodiceArticolo", StringType(), True),
    StructField("Value", FloatType(), True)
    # StructField("Value", DecimalType(10, 4), True)
])

# Create the Spark DataFrame directly from the static data and schema
df_dict = spark.createDataFrame(data=fasce, schema=schema)
Joino le fasce attive nel quarter di riferimento con le relative posizioni e calcolo le posizioni relativamente alle transazioni

windowSpec = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("basket").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

df_fasce = fasce_exploded.join(df_dict,how="inner",on=col("fascia_key")==col("basket"))\
            .select("category", "basket", "CodiceArticolo", "trans", "Value")\
            .withColumn("max_pos", sum("trans").over(windowSpec))\
            .withColumn("min_pos", coalesce((lag("max_pos", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("basket"))), lit(0)))
display(df_fasce)
Joino le transazioni private ordinate in base alla category e confrontando se la posizione della transazione è compresa tra la max e la min posizioni per una fascia

df_G_final = df_G.join(
                df_fasce,\
                (df_trx_private_ranked["category"] == df_fasce["category"]) &\
                (df_trx_private_ranked["row_number"] > df_fasce["min_pos"]) &\
                (df_trx_private_ranked["row_number"] <= df_fasce["max_pos"]),\
                how="inner")\
                .select("payment_id","recipient_id","internalistitutionid","taxcode","description","fasce_psp.category","prezzo_unitario","tipo_chiamata","CodiceArticolo","Value")\
                .withColumn("Value", col("Value").cast(DecimalType(10,4)))
df_final = df_G_final.union(df_non_G_final)

stazioni = df_final\
                .groupBy("category","recipient_id","internalistitutionid","taxcode","description","CodiceArticolo")\
                .pivot("tipo_chiamata",["ASYNC", "SYNC"])\
                .agg(
                    F.count("Value").alias("numero_tot"),\
                    F.sum("prezzo_unitario").alias("valore_tot")\

report_privati = df_final\
                .groupBy("category","recipient_id","internalistitutionid","taxcode","description","CodiceArticolo")\
                .agg(
                    F.count("Value").alias("numero_tot"),
                    F.sum("Value").alias("valore_tot")
                    )\
                .join(stazioni, on=["category","recipient_id","internalistitutionid","taxcode","description","CodiceArticolo"],how="inner")\
                .fillna(0)\
                .withColumn("year_quarter",lit(year_quarter))

dfEnti = spark.sql("""
                        SELECT internalistitutionid,
                            rootAggregator.institutionid as parentID,
                            rootAggregator.description as parentDescription
                        FROM pagopa.enti
                        WHERE institutiontype in ('GPU', 'PRV')
                        and product = 'prod-pagopa'
joinDfEnti = report_privati.join(dfEnti, on = "internalistitutionid", how="left")
display(joinDfEnti)
joinDfEnti.write.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table="stg.report_privati", mode = 'overwrite', properties=conn_Prop)
display(report_privati)
